description: This file is a Python script that implements a parser for C++ header files. It contains classes and functions to tokenize, parse, and build an abstract syntax tree of C++ code, including handling of classes, enums, typedefs, functions, variables, and various C++ constructs. The parser is designed to process C++ source code and generate data structures representing the code's structure.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom exception class for parsing errors, inherits from RuntimeError.

classes.name: LoaderError
classes.description: Custom exception class for file loading errors, inherits from RuntimeError.

classes.name: Ref
classes.description: Enumeration of reference types used in C++ type parsing, inherits from IntEnum.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class to hold metadata annotations and properties for parsed code elements.

classes.name: BaseType
classes.description: Base class for representing fundamental types in C++.

classes.name: Undefined
classes.description: Represents an undefined or unparsed type, inherits from BaseType.

classes.name: Fundamental
classes.description: Represents fundamental C++ types, inherits from BaseType.

classes.name: Intrinsic
classes.description: Represents intrinsic types, inherits from BaseType.

classes.name: BuiltinInteger
classes.description: Represents built-in integer types, inherits from Intrinsic.

classes.name: String
classes.description: Represents string types, inherits from Intrinsic.

classes.name: CCString
classes.description: Represents C-style string types, inherits from Intrinsic.

classes.name: Nullptr_t
classes.description: Represents the nullptr type, inherits from Fundamental.

classes.name: Void
classes.description: Represents the void type, inherits from Fundamental.

classes.name: Bool
classes.description: Represents the bool type, inherits from Fundamental.

classes.name: Integer
classes.description: Represents integer types, inherits from Fundamental.

classes.name: Float
classes.description: Represents floating point types, inherits from Fundamental.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Represents an identifier in C++, including name and type resolution.

classes.name: Name
classes.description: Represents a named entity with full qualification.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a block of code or scope, inherits from Name.

classes.name: Namespace
classes.description: Represents a C++ namespace, inherits from Block.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a C++ type with qualifiers and references.

classes.name: Typedef
classes.description: Represents a typedef declaration.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a C++ class or struct, inherits from Identifier and Block.

classes.name: Union
classes.description: Represents a C++ union, inherits from Identifier and Block.

classes.name: Enum
classes.description: Represents an enumeration, inherits from Identifier and Block.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a function or method, inherits from Block and Name.

classes.name: Temporary
classes.description: Represents a temporary variable or constant.

classes.name: Variable
classes.description: Represents a variable declaration.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Represents a function parameter.

classes.name: Method
classes.description: Represents a class method, inherits from Function.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a destructor, inherits from Method.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a class attribute or member variable.

classes.name: Enumerator
classes.description: Represents an enumeration item.

classes.name: TemplateNonTypeParameter
classes.description: Represents a non-type template parameter.

classes.name: TemplateTypeParameter
classes.description: Represents a type template parameter.

classes.name: InstantiatedTemplateClass
classes.description: Represents an instantiated template class with specific arguments.

classes.name: TemplateClass
classes.description: Represents a class template.

methods.name: ASSERT_ISVALID
methods.description: Asserts that a token is a valid identifier.

methods.name: ASSERT_ISEXPECTED
methods.description: Asserts that a token is in an expected list.

methods.name: CurrentFile
methods.description: Returns the current filename being parsed.

methods.name: CurrentLine
methods.description: Returns the current line number being parsed.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main function to parse C++ source code into a syntax tree.

methods.name: ParseFile
